faq_heading: Vancouver houses with suites: your questions answered

faq.q: How much does a Vancouver house with a suite cost?
faq.a: The 205 houses with a legal suite that sold between November 1, 2025 and October 31, 2026 had a median of $2,588,800, with the middle half between $1,925,000 and $3,180,000. Every Vancouver detached house had a median of $2,180,000.

faq.q: What is the difference between a legal and an unauthorized suite in Vancouver?
faq.a: A legal suite is listed as Legal Suite or Licensed Suite, and an unauthorized one as Unauthorized Suite. 205 Vancouver houses sold with a legal suite and 352 with an unauthorized one, which had a median of $1,880,500.

faq.q: What lot size does a Vancouver multiplex need?
faq.a: R1-1 sets the minimum site area at 306 square metres for a house, duplex or 3 to 4 unit multiple dwelling, 464 square metres for 5 units, and 557 square metres for 6 to 8 units.

faq.q: When did Vancouver switch to the R1-1 zone?
faq.a: On October 17, 2023, when it replaced nine RS zones with one for about 65,000 lots.

faq.q: Which Vancouver neighbourhoods have the most houses with legal suites?
faq.a: South Vancouver had 19 legal-suite sales, Grandview Woodland 15 and Kitsilano 15 between November 1, 2025 and October 31, 2026.

faq.q: How fast do Vancouver houses with a legal suite sell?
faq.a: 18 days at a median, closing at 96.9% of list, with 14% over the list price.

blocks.text: Draft for Jared’s approval. Sold figures come from Paragon closed and pending sales to October 31, 2026. A pending sale is firm but has not completed, so its price can still change. The live search is not connected yet.

This search lists detached houses for sale in Vancouver West and Vancouver East that have a suite, legal or marked unauthorized. The busiest areas by house sales were Dunbar (113), Renfrew (103), Kitsilano (80), Point Grey (74) and Knight (74). Condos, townhomes and half duplexes are separate searches.

Of 1,457 detached houses that sold in Vancouver between November 1, 2025 and October 31, 2026, 557 (38%) had a suite: 205 legal and 352 unauthorized. The legal-suite houses sold for a median of $2,588,800, 19% more than the $2,180,000 median for every Vancouver house.

blocks.text: The typical legal-suite house sits on 4,026 sq ft, against 4,191 sq ft for all Vancouver houses. It has 2,898 square feet of floor area, against 2,554. 93% of legal-suite houses have two or more kitchens, compared with 59% of all houses. Unauthorized-suite houses were smaller at 2,442 square feet and a median $1,880,500.

Alongside suites, 539 Vancouver houses had lane access, at a median of $2,150,000; 54 were marked as a coach or laneway house at $2,639,000; 15 had a second residence on the lot. These are separate flags in the same Paragon records, and a house can carry more than one.

blocks.text: Vancouver replaced nine RS zones with one R1-1 zone on October 17, 2023, covering about 65,000 lots. On an R1-1 lot an owner can have a house with a suite or a laneway house, a duplex, a character-retention project, or a multiplex of 3 to 6 strata units or up to 8 rental units.

Minimum site area under the schedule is 306 square metres for a house, a duplex or a 3 to 4 unit multiple dwelling, 464 square metres for 5 units, and 557 square metres for 6 to 8 units. A lot that clears those can carry a multiplex as well as a suite and a laneway house in the forms the schedule states.

The Empty Homes Tax charges 3% of assessed value on a home that is neither lived in nor rented, and the Tenant Relocation and Protection Policy applies across the city when a rented building is redeveloped. A rented suite touches both.

The MLS® Home Price Index benchmark for a detached house in Vancouver West was $2,899,700 in October 2026, 9.0% down over twelve months. In Vancouver East it was $1,610,700. The benchmark is the price of a typical house, not a median of sales.
Before you offer on a Vancouver house with a suite

items.t: Ask for the Vancouver permit and final inspection for the suite. 352 of the 557 suite houses sold here were unauthorized, so the paperwork comes first.

If the suite is rented, ask for the tenancy agreement and the rent. The Tenant Relocation and Protection Policy applies if a rented building is redeveloped, which matters on a lot that could carry a multiplex.
Check the lot against the R1-1 schedule. A house with a suite or a laneway house needs less than a multiplex, and a multiplex needs 306 to 557 square metres depending on the number of units.
If a tenant lives in the suite, ask for the tenancy agreement and the rent; a tenancy usually carries on after a sale. Legal-suite houses took 18 days to sell, so there is time to ask.

If the listing says unauthorized, compare the price with the $1,880,500 median for unauthorized-suite houses and the $2,588,800 median for legal ones, then decide whether to legalize the suite or remove it.
